title: Rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis and methotrexate
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's arthritis and related long-term drug therapy.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for rheumatoid arthritis.

HPI
Pt is an 80-year-old female presenting for routine follow-up of rheumatoid arthritis. She has been on a stable regimen of methotrexate and folic acid for several years. Pt reports that her symptoms are currently well-controlled. She denies any acute flares, significant morning stiffness, or new areas of discomfort. She reports good adherence to her medication schedule. She notes some mild fatigue but denies any systemic symptoms like fever or chills.

Medication List
- Methotrexate 15mg PO weekly
- Folic acid 1mg PO daily
- Multivitamin daily

Review of Systems
Constitutional: Denies fever, chills, weight change, or fatigue.
Musculoskeletal: Denies new joint pain or swelling.
Skin: No rashes or lesions.
Respiratory: Denies SOB or cough.
Neurological: No numbness or tingling.
All other systems reviewed and negative.

Social History
Pt lives at home with her daughter. Retired. No tobacco use. Occasional social drinking.

Family History
Mother: RA, age 75.
Father: Hypertension, stroke.

Vitals
BP: 128/78
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 98% on RA
Ht/Wt: 54 kg

Recent Labs
CBC: WBC 7.2, Hb 12.1, Plt 210
CMP: Na 139, K 4.1, Cr 0.9, eGFR 75
Methotrexate monitoring: Liver enzymes WNL.

Exam
General: Alert, oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Skin: No visible erythema or nodules.
Musculoskeletal: No overt swelling or warmth noted.
Respiratory: CTAB, lungs clear to auscultation.
Cardiovascular: RRR, no murmurs.
Neurological: Alert and oriented, no focal deficits.

Assessment
1. Rheumatoid arthritis: Stable on current methotrexate.

Plan
1. Continue methotrexate weekly.
2. Continue folic acid daily.
3. Follow up in 3 months for lab work and clinical assessment.
4. Pt to call if any new symptoms or adverse reactions occur.

Electronically signed, T. Haddad, NP, 05/14/2026
explanations: Rheumatoid arthritis, nothing more specified: M06.9 (HCC 93).

distractors.why: Rheumatoid factor status is not documented.
Methotrexate has its own long-term use code, Z79.631.
